description.short: Understand connectivity health before and during Microsoft Teams meetings.
description.full:
SignalTuner helps meeting participants and support staff understand connectivity problems within Microsoft Teams.

**A SignalTuner account is required to access and use the app's functionality.** Sign in with your existing SignalTuner account or [Sign up](${{TAB_ENDPOINT}}/tabs/create-account) using the app's account creation page.

**What you can do**

- View your connectivity dashboard and monitor Teams service incidents.
- Share connectivity status with other signed-in SignalTuner participants in a meeting.
- Request five-minute connectivity analyses and review meeting history.

**Get started**

Live device telemetry and device analyses require the SignalTuner desktop app on the computer being monitored. [Get started: download the desktop app](https://www.signaltuner.com/downloads/) from the SignalTuner website, then follow the activation steps in the app.

**Requirements and limitations**

Reports use credits, and analyses of other participants follow account permissions and device-consent rules. Meeting invitations require the SignalTuner bot to be installed in the meeting chat; channel-meeting invitations are not supported.

**Help and support**

Open [Setup guide](https://www.signaltuner.com/setup-guide), or [Contact support](mailto:support@signaltuner.com) at support@signaltuner.com.
